decision.observed_event: You declare: "I step in and let my eyes catch the light. 'Cousins. I didn't know there were others of the blood this close to the surface.'"

appraisal.label: interest
appraisal.cause: A genuine half-vampire greets the fake vampires as kin.

improv_read.player_bid: Vesna, part-vampire, greets the table as kin.
improv_read.connection: The act depends on nobody real calling it; Uktarl must bluff harder before this stranger tests it.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit shows the ruse bending under a real predator: the act wobbles in the minor players and hardens in the dealer.

public_brief.objective: Keep the act alive in front of someone who may be the real thing, and find out what she knows.
public_brief.tactic: Bluff harder: embrace the kinship with courtly warmth and fish for her lineage before she can test him.
public_brief.visible_cue: Her eyes reflect the candles; one player drops his cards and another stops looking up.
public_brief.player_opening: She can name a house, test him, or take the seat.
public_brief.reply_to: Cousins. I didn't know there were others of the blood this close to the surface.
public_brief.kit_focus: Let the table split: one player drops his cards, one goes silent, while the dealer leans into the bluff.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: let the dealer play courtly host to a dangerous guest
public_brief.npc_notice: stunt: her eyeshine looks like the real thing, which threatens the act the dealer must keep convincing

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Her eyes take the candlelight and throw it back, a cold shine no living face should have. The door-side player's cards slip out of his fingers. The fresco-side player stares at his coins and does not look up again.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Cousins, she says. How long it has been since anyone of the old blood came calling at our little table. Forgive my brothers, they are shy of strangers, even family. Come, cousin, sit with us. Tell me which house you hail from, so I know what courtesies we owe you?

segments.speaker: Door-side player
segments.text: She's... her eyes. Did you see her...
